title: 🔥 SOMETHING IS COMING... 🔥
paragraphs: For months, we've been praying, designing, refining, and building something that goes beyond apparel.

It's a reminder of who you are when the battle gets heavy.
A declaration of faith when words are hard to find.
A wearable testimony of God's strength in the middle of life's warfare.
Today, we're excited to share the first sample pieces from our upcoming Christian apparel collection.
Featuring a minimalist front design and a cinematic oversized back print, this piece is built to be bold without being loud—faith-centered, timeless, and wearable.

More designs.
More stories.
More reminders of God's faithfulness.

We're building a collection for:
🖤 The faithful in waiting
🖤 The weary believer
🖤 The wilderness survivor
🖤 The restored prodigal
🖤 Those who choose faith over fear
These are sample products, and we'd love your feedback before launch.

👇 What do you think of the first design?
Would you wear these?
